_comment: MEAT PARTY board: a loop of spaces, walked in order. Types: start tickets item hazard note clue caller steal medic door. 'pos' is metres on the hall floor (x, z). Add or reorder spaces freely; three 'clue' spaces (clue 0,1,2) and one 'door' are needed for the escape.
name: THE FUNCTION ROOM

spaces.text: A name tag on the floor: HELLO MY NAME IS ___. Someone has written underneath: 'he can't count us if we hold hands'.
The wallpaper here is peeling. Underneath, in crayon: a number, and an arrow toward the door. 'IT ISN'T PAINTED ON.'
Inside a crushed party hat: a number inked on the band. 'THE BOMB HAS A KEY. IT WON'T LET ONE PERSON WIND IT.'
Scratched into the skirting board: 'THE POPPER DOESN'T GO OFF IF NOBODY PICKS IT UP. WE TRIED. ALL OF US.'
A photo pinned under a chair: last year's contestants at the door, all pushing at once. A number on the back.
